superseded.note: a failed step retried successfully is not graded on the failed attempt
an unverified click retried into a verified one is likewise graded on the retry
superseded_by pointing at a step that does not exist hides a real failure
the last attempt is never superseded, so its failure still counts

provenance: the relocation and replan ladders need failed attempts to stop failing the whole run, or no recovery could ever be graded PASS. That exemption is a hole in the verifier by construction, so it gets pinned before it is trusted: a supersede is only honored when the step it points at is really in the trace, and the final attempt in a chain is never exempt. Written after noticing that `superseded_by: 999` would have silently laundered any failed step into a passing run.

triage.note: verifier exemption added for M3 ladders; watched red with the exemption ungated
